newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Soros takes stake in Venezuela property fund.
newsitem.headline: Soros takes stake in Venezuela property fund.

text.p: Financier George Soros has taken a majority stake in Venezuelan real estate fund Fondo de Valores Inmobiliario (FVI), FVI President Luis Emilio Velutini said.

Soros-controlled Argentine real estate company IRSA S.A. paid $16 million for a 28.6 percent share, while Soros's Quantum Industrial Fund paid $14 million for 25 percent of the real estate company, which controls some 60,000 square metres of office and commercial space.

The company, which plans to acquire another 40,000 square metres of property by the end of the year, will capitalise on "our knowledge of the local market, the current opportunities that Venezuela offers and IRSA's experience in Argentina," Velutini said. "Venezuelan rents have not adjusted to inflation and we don't see enough space for the growing need of the next two years."
Other investors include Venezuela's Bancaracas Capital Markets, Andino Capital Markets, Geosor and Dolphin Ltd. Total new investments of $56 million take FVI's paid-up capital to $70 million.
Soros first entered the Venezuelan market in March when Quantum bought 9.4 percent in Banco Provincial.
